intro: MANAGE Hyderabad and VVISM both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded MBA / PGDM fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

MANAGE Hyderabad vs VVISM is not a single winner. MANAGE Hyderabad is recorded as a public institute, while VVISM is private. MANAGE Hyderabad holds a NIRF 2025 rank of 95; VVISM has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: MANAGE Hyderabad vs VVISM for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MANAGE Hyderabad if you want a public MBA / PGDM option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus, including the stronger NIRF 2025 rank on this page.
Choose VVISM if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

MANAGE Hyderabad lists Post Graduate Diploma in Agricultural Extension Management (PGDAEM), Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Agri Business. VVISM lists MBA Entrepreneurship, MBA Financial Management, MBA Human Resource Management and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
MANAGE's official mandatory disclosure lists the PGDM (Agri Business Management) fee as ₹9.75 lakh for the two-year programme.
On this page we record a programme total of ₹5.85 lakh for VVISM's MBA Operations & Systems.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for MANAGE Hyderabad on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.

In our records, VVISM's 2024 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Business Analytics. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: MANAGE Hyderabad's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT.
VVISM's recorded admission tests on this page include CAT.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, MANAGE Hyderabad is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
VVISM can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
